//: Each region becomes one shard. `geofabrik` is the path under https://download.geofabrik.de/ (region id = last path segment). `countryCodes` and `subdivisionCodes` preserve upstream ISO routing metadata. `bbox` is official source coverage in [minLat,minLon,maxLat,maxLon] order; minLon > maxLon wraps across the antimeridian. Optional `pbf` pins a local file instead of downloading (useful for tests). Optional `overrides` merges into the shard's rangefind config.
